title: Almond Blossom
description: White blossoms reach across a clear turquoise sky. Dark, branching contours give each delicate flower a quiet presence.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam · Wikimedia Commons

title: Irises
description: Violet irises rise from a tangle of pointed green leaves. A single pale flower interrupts the rhythm of the crowded garden.
collection: J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles
credit: Vincent van Gogh · J. Paul Getty Museum, Los Angeles · Wikimedia Commons

title: A Wheatfield, with Cypresses
description: Golden wheat bends beneath rolling clouds. Dark cypresses stand against the restless curves of the field and sky.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · The National Gallery, London · Wikimedia Commons

title: Sunflowers
description: Ochre, amber and gold fill a simple vase. Flowers at different stages of life turn a familiar still life into a study of luminous yellow.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · The National Gallery, London · Wikimedia Commons

title: The Bedroom
description: Blue walls meet warm wooden furniture and a red blanket. Tilted lines bring an intimate room close to the viewer.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam · Wikimedia Commons

title: The Yellow House
description: Sunlit yellow buildings stand beneath a saturated blue sky. Small figures and a distant train bring movement to the street.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam · Wikimedia Commons

title: The Starry Night
description: Stars radiate through a sky of sweeping blue curves. A dark cypress rises above the small, still village below.
collection: The Museum of Modern Art, New York
credit: Vincent van Gogh · The Museum of Modern Art, New York · Wikimedia Commons

title: Starry Night over the Rhône
description: Golden lights stretch across deep blue water. Beneath the stars, two figures stand together at the river’s edge.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Musée d’Orsay, Paris · Wikimedia Commons

title: Café Terrace at Night
description: A brilliant yellow café spills light onto the cobbled street. Deep blue buildings frame a small opening of star-filled sky.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Kröller-Müller Museum, Otterlo · Wikimedia Commons

title: Garden with Courting Couples: Square Saint-Pierre
description: Small figures walk and sit beneath young trees. Short strokes of green and yellow cover the garden and its curving paths.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation) · Wikimedia Commons

title: First Steps, after Millet
description: A child stretches toward a kneeling figure across a garden path. Pale greens, blue clothing and flowering trees frame the family.
collection: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
credit: Vincent van Gogh · The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York · Wikimedia Commons

title: The Sower
description: A large yellow sun rises above a blue-violet field. A figure scatters seed across the thickly painted earth.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Kröller-Müller Museum, Otterlo · Wikimedia Commons

title: The Red Vineyard
description: Workers bend among red and orange vines beneath a yellow sky. A bright sun and reflective water mark the distant edge of the field.
collection: The Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Moscow
credit: Vincent van Gogh · The Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts, Moscow · Wikimedia Commons

title: The Mulberry Tree
description: Golden leaves spread from a dark, twisting trunk. Curving brushstrokes cross the blue sky and pale ground around the tree.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Norton Simon Museum, Pasadena · Wikimedia Commons

title: The Sea at Les Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer
description: Green and blue waves break into white crests in the foreground. Small sails cross the water beneath a pale, clouded sky.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation) · Wikimedia Commons

title: Road with Cypress and Star
description: A tall cypress divides a sky lit by a star and crescent moon. Two figures and a carriage travel along the pale winding road.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Kröller-Müller Museum, Otterlo · Wikimedia Commons

title: Self-Portrait
description: A red beard and attentive gaze stand against swirling blue-green strokes. The cool tones continue through the jacket and background.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Musée d’Orsay, Paris · Wikimedia Commons

title: Olive Trees with Yellow Sky and Sun
description: Gnarled olive trunks rise from orange and violet earth. A yellow sun shines above the grove and a line of blue mountains.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Minneapolis Institute of Art, Minneapolis · Wikimedia Commons

title: Wheatfield under Thunderclouds
description: An expansive green wheatfield stretches beneath deep blue clouds. Broad horizontal bands carry the landscape toward the horizon.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation) · Wikimedia Commons

title: Tree Roots
description: Interlaced roots and tree trunks fill the canvas. Patches of blue, green and ochre trace the exposed earth and tangled growth.
credit: Vincent van Gogh · Van Gogh Museum, Amsterdam (Vincent van Gogh Foundation) · Wikimedia Commons
